info.title: Payment Order Initiation
info.description:
This service domain provides a customer payment service. It captures the
    payer and payee details and other key properties of the payment and
    initiates the orchestration of the transaction. It provides support for
    repeating/scheduled payment

put.summary: UpCR Update details of a payment transaction instruction
EcBQ Verify or accept the payment transaction (results in a payment order)

get.summary: ReCR Retrieve details about a payment transaction
ReBQ Retrieve details about the payment order initiation
ReBQ Retrieve details about a payment transaction funds available
ReBQ Retrieve details about a payment transaction compliance check
